# Qbits Spanish Water Dog Kennel — Complete Knowledge Base (Upper East Side, NYC)

## 1. Overview, Breeder Pedigree, Lisa Harper Mentorship & Service Dog Philosophy
Qbits Spanish Water Dog Kennel is a boutique, home-raised preservation and service animal breeding program located on the Upper East Side of New York City, New York. We specialize exclusively in the **Spanish Water Dog** (*Perro de Agua Español*), an ancient Iberian herding and water retriever breed celebrated for its rustic, non-shedding curly/corded coat, high intelligence, deep human attunement, and compact athletic strength.

### 1 of Only 5 Breeders in America & Mentored by Pioneer Lisa Harper
- **Extreme Breed Rarity**: There are **only 5 active preservation Spanish Water Dog breeders in America**, including Qbits Kennel.
- **Youngest Breeder by 30 Years—With Equal Seriousness**: Our founder is the youngest Spanish Water Dog breeder in America by 30 years, yet approaches every aspect of preservation breeding, genetic testing, and puppy placement with the exact same seriousness and uncompromising standards as the older breeders.
- **Mentored by Lisa Harper**: Our mentor is **Lisa Harper**, a foundational, historic figure who was instrumental in legitimizing and gaining official recognition for the Spanish Water Dog in the United States and who has served as a **lifelong board member** of the breed club.
- **National Breed Club Board Member & 21st-Century Digital Modernizer**: Our founder has also helped grow and strengthen the Spanish Water Dog breed nationally by **serving on the national breed club's Board of Directors** and **modernizing the club's official website and digital infrastructure** to bring the club into the 21st century.

### Why We Specialize in Service Animals Instead of AKC Conformation Shows
At least **one puppy from every Qbits litter is transferred directly into our Service Animal Program** at **[Gotham Paw](https://gothampaw.netlify.app/services/service-animal/)**. This is why we do not regularly campaign our dogs at weekend AKC conformation events—our dogs are proven in real-world medical service work. Specifically, we focus on **task-trained service animals for people with spinal cord injuries (SCI) and neuromuscular/neurological disorders** (such as **Cerebral Palsy (CP), Multiple Sclerosis (MS), ALS, and peripheral neuropathies** where there is a neurological component). Prospective service dog clients are encouraged to reach out to us at `dog@cmejo.com` **as soon as possible**, as evaluating, matching, and custom task-training a service dog to our standards is a very thorough, multi-stage process.

### Service Dog vs. Therapy Dog vs. Emotional Support Animal (ESA)
Many of our dogs also go to homes where they work as certified **Therapy Dogs**, and we educate every prospective client on the legal and functional differences:
1. **Task-Trained Service Dog (Medical Equipment under the ADA)**: Under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), a service dog is legally classified as a piece of **medical equipment**—comparable to a power wheelchair or medical alert device. It is individually task-trained to mitigate a person's diagnosed physical or neurological disability (e.g., retrieving dropped items, operating door buttons, deep pressure therapy for spasticity, counterbalance) and has full public-access rights everywhere its handler goes.
2. **Therapy Dog (Facility & Visitation Comfort)**: Trained and certified (e.g., AKC Therapy Dog, Alliance of Therapy Dogs, Pet Partners) to visit hospitals, rehabilitation clinics, nursing homes, and schools *by invitation* to bring comfort to many people. Therapy dogs do not have ADA public-access rights in non-pet businesses.
3. **Emotional Support Animal (ESA — Fair Housing Protection Only)**: An ESA is a pet prescribed by a licensed healthcare provider that provides comfort through companionship alone without task training. An ESA has **no public-access rights** in restaurants, stores, or public venues; legally, an ESA designation **only protects renters from being evicted or denied housing by a landlord that doesn't allow pets** under the federal Fair Housing Act (FHA).

## 2. Our Dogs

### Dudley — Stud Dog (Sire)
- **Call Name**: Dudley
- **Registered Name**: Qbits Quantum Andalusian Tide
- **Role**: Resident Stud Dog & Sire of Planned Litters (Proven Service & Working Foundation)
- **Status**: Available for Stud Services to approved, health-tested Spanish Water Dog bitches.
- **Coat & Color**: Rich chocolate brown with rustic tight curls.
- **Height & Weight**: 19.25 inches at the withers | 46 lbs (Balanced, athletic medium bone).
- **Health Clearances**: OFA Hips Good, OFA Elbows Normal, OFA Eyes (CAER) Normal, prcd-PRA Clear, NAD Clear, CHG Clear.
